Jared S. (Support): FYI escalated account: BrightLane (trial) getting 403 on ingest, blocked last 1h. Renew risk if not resolved by EOD.
Priya R. (CSM): Can you drop the tenant id + last successful timeframe? I'm with the customer on a call at 3pm PT.
Jared S. (Support): tenant=bl-prod-231, last success 2024-11-12T09:12Z. Error in logs below:
```
POST /v1/ingest 403
{ "error": "quota_exceeded" }
```
Miriam L. (CS Ops): 403 quota_exceeded usually means provisioning mismatch. Which plan did they request? Any pending invoices?
Jared S. (Support): They signed up self-serve, trial 30k token embed quota. No invoices. The billing events show no reservation. Might be provisioning bug on dedicated mapping.
Aaron K. (AE): CC'ing me — renewal conversation scheduled next week. If this blocks onboarding we lose momentum. Prioritize please :exclamation:
Priya R. (CSM): Owner request: Miriam / Support to own triage today, I'll run comms with customer and propose a mitigator (manual bump) so they can continue the demo.
Miriam L. (CS Ops): On it. I'll check mappings and quota allocation. Tentative mitigation: set temporary quota + audit role.mapping. If it looks like dedicated mapping regression, we'll rollback yesterday's infra change.
escalation-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2024-5873 assigned to eng-infra, severity: high
Jared S. (Support): I pushed a quick log snippet to the ticket and added the curl reproduce command.
Priya R. (CSM): For comms plan: 1) Send BrightLane a heads-up that we're working on a fix and provide a manual quota bump for 24h. 2) Offer a follow-up demo with product success leads. 3) Escalate to AE if fix > 6h. I'll draft message.
Aaron K. (AE): Good plan. Please copy me on the manual bump and the follow-up cadence. If they escalate we can offer a temporary credit.
Miriam L. (CS Ops): Update 10m: found missing tier mapping for new trial cohorts; applying hotfix now. Will update ticket + ping when done.
Jared S. (Support): Thanks — customer back online after manual bump. They're able to proceed with demo. Leaving follow-up with Priya for renewal signal.
Priya R. (CSM): I'll close the loop with BrightLane and add this to the renewal watch list. Action owners: Miriam (hotfix verification), Jared (support follow-ups), Aaron (AE renewal touch). Thanks team :heart:
